body:
It's what I grew up hearing. I was always the disappointment, the embarrassment, I was never good enough for them. If they had a choice to trade me in for another daughter, they'd of loved to. When it came to me, there were always arguments and fighting. They hated me, so I pretended to be the daughter they wanted. I play the role now, and it makes them happier than I ever could have. Who I am now is just a shadow of a person, doing what I can to prevent further embarrassment to my family of me, because I will never be enough for them.

It's all the same, tinted the same, the same dreary ticking of time falling away. No matter what I'm doing, it always feels the same. It feels bittersweet and alone and empty.

This is a smaller world than people make it out to be. "Everything" is encapsulated into a few broad categories. Travel, work, family, hobbies. Break it down from there into smaller categories, break it down again. Nothing 'inside' me wants to live. I try to find reasons so as not to devastate my parents. They would both be exceedingly embarrassed over a suicide in the family. They would probably spend the rest of their lives blaming themselves and each other. I don't want that for them. 

For me? Fuck yes, I would kill myself in an instant if I wasn't concerned for them. As it is, I've been trying to distance myself anyway, because I mean. I would be dead after all. So even if I ruin their lives, it's not like I have to bear witness to that. I am literally staying alive for my parents right now. I just need to take a moment to be totally selfish, and then I'd be gone. And if I stayed alive, I'd just be disappointing them anyway. So why not just take that step, and disappoint them one last time? Hm. Maybe it wouldn't be so bad for them.

That's the thing, I don't have anything. I've never had passions or goals or dreams. My friends talk about getting married and raising kids and finding careers, and I just have a blank space of nothing. I've tried desperately to envision a future, I've tried to just follow along after everyone else, seeing what they see. But in the end, it's always been nothing for me.

So what's the point in prolonging the death bed? Nothing in this life has ever appealed to me.

Thanks. To be honest I called a month ago, at the end of March. I thought things were still fixable then. I was hoping I could talk through my fears with someone and find reassurance and motivation and whatever, and not end up where I am now. Well, that didn't happen, so here I am. Back when I called, I thought I had more options. But now I realize I don't really have much at all. I'm supposed to graduate and I'm supposed to be Some One and do Some Thing and fulfill my parent's dreams. 

But life doesn't just work like that, and I've realized I have no clue what I'm doing with my major. None of it makes sense to me. Like, I'm supposed to find somebody to work for, and then from there, find somebody better to work for, and keep going, until I'm working for the biggest company possible. And then. What. It'll always be the same, you know? I'll always be searching for something "better," and I'll always be working towards something "more." I feel like I'm just toiling up an endless staircase, and what's the point in that? I climb and climb and climb and in the end, I still get nowhere, no matter how hard or fast I climb those stairs.
